title: Goals & challenges
intro: Small, friendly goals to enjoy your wardrobe more. Go at your own pace — you can pause or change them anytime.

empty.title: No goal right now
empty.message: Pick a goal or a challenge below whenever you feel like it.

stopMessage: It moves to your past goals. You can start it again whenever you like.

templateDesc.wear_forgotten: Bring back pieces you haven't worn in a while.
templateDesc.reduce_impulse: Set a gentle limit on purchases for a month.
templateDesc.create_outfits: Put together new combinations from what you own.
templateDesc.monthly_budget: Keep your clothing spending within a monthly amount.
templateDesc.organize: Add photos, colors, seasons and styles to your items.
templateDesc.capsule: Choose a small set of versatile pieces to wear.
templateDesc.challenge_7x7: Seven days, a different outfit each day.
templateDesc.challenge_no_shopping: Take a break from buying clothes for 30 days.
templateDesc.challenge_capsule: Live with a capsule of selected pieces for three months.
